RoadInspection.title: RoadInspection
RoadInspection.description: AI road surveillance video analysis record with detected pavement damages, 12-month PCI degradation & Google rainfall forecast, and preventive maintenance schedule.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this road inspection.

roadName.description: Name or code of the inspected road corridor.

segmentLocation.description: Optional kilometer marker or segment location description.

regionName.description: Region/regency/province used for Google rainfall lookup.

videoSourceLabel.description: Video source label and duration summary.

framesAnalyzed.description: Number of extracted video keyframes analyzed by AI.

roadSummary.description: AI visual summary of pavement condition from surveillance frames.

pciScore.description: Current Pavement Condition Index score from 0 to 100.

iriEstimate.description: Estimated International Roughness Index in m/km.

optimalMaintenanceMonth.description: Recommended month and year for timely preventive maintenance.

urgencyWindow.description: Recommended action timeframe before critical degradation.

maintenanceRationale.description: AI engineering rationale explaining why the recommended month is optimal considering rainfall and degradation.

rainfallSummary.description: Summary of Google regional monthly rainfall pattern affecting repair scheduling.

rainfallSourceNote.description: Attribution note for Google Search rainfall grounding sources.

costSavingsPercent.description: Estimated lifecycle cost savings percentage from timely preventive maintenance.

maintenanceNotes.description: Optional field engineer notes for the maintenance schedule.

damages.description: Bounded list (max 10) of road damages detected in surveillance frames.

forecast.description: Bounded list (max 13) of monthly predicted PCI degradation and rainfall (mm) points.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/inspections/{inspectionI.description: User-scoped road surveillance AI inspection reports and rainfall-aware preventive maintenance schedules.
